splits.text: Used 2 eggs for breakfast. Bought bread. What should I cook with the chicken thing my mom left?
We finished the coffee! Add oat milk to the list. Kids made some slime with glue and stuff.
Out of dish soap. Out of shampoo. Low on toilet paper. My sister might bring some laundry stuff.
Bought 2 litres of milk at Costco. They were out of eggs so maybe next time.
Thanks Tote. We're out of rice.
Used the last of the butter. Is there any jam left? Also I burned something weird in the oven.
Need onions. Need garlic. What can I make for dinner?
I cooked pasta tonight. Used all the spaghetti and half the sauce.
Add milk. Add eggs. Add bread. Add butter. Add jam.
Ran out of ketchup. Need to grab paper towels. Not sure what I did with the rest of the cheese.
Wipes are running low. So is the hand soap.
Do we have rice? I want to make that biryani my aunt makes.
I'm thinking of going vegetarian. Probably should use up the chicken sometime.
Bought eggs. Not the usual ones, the brown kind.
Milk went bad. Threw it out.
My husband says we have no sugar. I doubt that. Check later.
